arabic text: HAAYE ZAHRA TERI TANHAI HAI, TANHAI ALI KI\nHAAYE GHAM MEIN TERE JAATI RAHI BEENAAYI ALI KI
english translation text: ALAS, ZAHRA (AS), YOUR LONELINESS IS THE LONELINESS OF ALI (AS)\nALAS, IN GRIEF FOR YOU, THE SIGHT OF ALI (AS) WAS LOST

arabic text: TERI TANHAI HAI, TANHAI ALI KI\nHAAYE ZAHRA TERI TANHAI HAI, TANHAI ALI KI
english translation text: YOUR LONELINESS IS THE LONELINESS OF ALI (AS)\nALAS, ZAHRA (AS), YOUR LONELINESS IS THE LONELINESS OF ALI (AS)

arabic text: DARBAAR MEIN ZAALIM KE GAYI BINT-E-PAYAMBAR\nKYA WAQT THA, KUCH KAR NA SAKA FAATEH-E-KHAIBAR\nHAAYE HANSTE RAHE GHURBAT PE TAMAASHAAYI ALI KI
english translation text: THE PROPHET'S (SAWW) DAUGHTER WENT TO THE OPPRESSOR'S COURT\nWHAT A TIME IT WAS: THE CONQUEROR OF KHAIBAR COULD DO NOTHING\nALAS, THE ONLOOKERS KEPT LAUGHING AT THE HELPLESSNESS OF ALI (AS)

arabic text: TERI TANHAI HAI, TANHAI ALI KI\nHAAYE ZAHRA TERI TANHAI HAI, TANHAI ALI KI
english translation text: YOUR LONELINESS IS THE LONELINESS OF ALI (AS)\nALAS, ZAHRA (AS), YOUR LONELINESS IS THE LONELINESS OF ALI (AS)

arabic text: PAIGHAAM-E-WILAAYAT LIYE GHAR GHAR GAYI ZAHRA\nSHOHAR KE LIYE DHAAL THI JAB TAK RAHI ZINDA\nHAAYE DUNYA KO BATAATI RAHI SACHCHAAYI ALI KI
english translation text: CARRYING THE MESSAGE OF WILAYAH, ZAHRA (AS) WENT FROM HOUSE TO HOUSE\nAS LONG AS SHE LIVED, SHE WAS A SHIELD FOR HER HUSBAND\nALAS, SHE KEPT TELLING THE WORLD THE TRUTH OF ALI (AS)

arabic text: TERI TANHAI HAI, TANHAI ALI KI\nHAAYE ZAHRA TERI TANHAI HAI, TANHAI ALI KI
english translation text: YOUR LONELINESS IS THE LONELINESS OF ALI (AS)\nALAS, ZAHRA (AS), YOUR LONELINESS IS THE LONELINESS OF ALI (AS)

arabic text: KEHTE THE ALI ZAHRA SE, KYA HAAL HAI BIBI\nAB HUM KO SALAAM AA KE BHI KARTA NAHIN KOI\nHAAYE HAI BAAD-E-NABI KAISI PAZEERAAYI ALI KI
english translation text: ALI (AS) WOULD SAY TO ZAHRA (AS): "WHAT A STATE WE ARE IN, BIBI!\nNOW NO ONE EVEN COMES TO GREET US WITH SALAAM"\nALAS, AFTER THE PROPHET (SAWW), WHAT A WELCOME FOR ALI (AS)

arabic text: TERI TANHAI HAI, TANHAI ALI KI\nHAAYE ZAHRA TERI TANHAI HAI, TANHAI ALI KI
english translation text: YOUR LONELINESS IS THE LONELINESS OF ALI (AS)\nALAS, ZAHRA (AS), YOUR LONELINESS IS THE LONELINESS OF ALI (AS)

arabic text: DAR JALTA HUWA FATEMA ZAHRA PE GIRAAYA\nMOHSIN KI SHAHAADAT KA SABAB BAN GAYI DUNYA\nHAAYE TASVEER MUKAMMAL NAHIN HO PAAYI ALI KI
english translation text: THEY BROUGHT THE BURNING DOOR DOWN UPON BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS)\nTHE WORLD BECAME THE CAUSE OF THE MARTYRDOM OF MOHSIN (AS)\nALAS, THE PICTURE OF ALI (AS) COULD NOT BE MADE COMPLETE

english translation text: YOUR LONELINESS IS THE LONELINESS OF ALI (AS)\nALAS, ZAHRA (AS), YOUR LONELINESS IS THE LONELINESS OF ALI (AS)

arabic text: BAAHAR KABHI, HUJRE MEIN KABHI, QABR-E-NABI PAR\nHAR RAAT KI TAAREEKI MEIN AULAAD SE CHHUP KAR\nHAAYE NIKLI HAI TUJHE DHOONDHNE BEENAAYI ALI KI
english translation text: SOMETIMES OUTSIDE, SOMETIMES IN THE ROOM, SOMETIMES AT THE PROPHET'S (SAWW) GRAVE\nIN THE DARKNESS OF EVERY NIGHT, HIDDEN FROM THE CHILDREN\nALAS, THE SIGHT OF ALI (AS) HAS GONE OUT SEARCHING FOR YOU

english translation text: YOUR LONELINESS IS THE LONELINESS OF ALI (AS)\nALAS, ZAHRA (AS), YOUR LONELINESS IS THE LONELINESS OF ALI (AS)

arabic text: ZAHRA KI JUDAAI KO LAGAAYE HUWE DIL SE\nPACHEES BARAS MAULA NE CHUP CHAAP GUZAARE\nHAAYE EK HUJRE MEIN KUL DUNYA SIMAT AAYI ALI KI
english translation text: HOLDING THE PARTING FROM ZAHRA (AS) CLOSE TO HIS HEART\nTHE MAULA (AS) PASSED TWENTY-FIVE YEARS IN SILENCE\nALAS, THE WHOLE WORLD OF ALI (AS) WAS GATHERED INTO ONE ROOM

english translation text: YOUR LONELINESS IS THE LONELINESS OF ALI (AS)\nALAS, ZAHRA (AS), YOUR LONELINESS IS THE LONELINESS OF ALI (AS)

arabic text: US WAQT TAKALLUM WOH ZAMAANE KA WALI THA\nSAJJAD JO ZAINAB KO LIYE SHAAM SE GUZRA\nHAAYE ISLAAM KO KHAAMOSHI BACHA LAAYI ALI KI
english translation text: AT THAT TIME, TAKALLUM, HE WAS THE GUARDIAN OF THE AGE:\nSAJJAD (AS), WHO PASSED THROUGH SHAAM WITH ZAINAB (SA)\nALAS, THE SILENCE OF ALI (AS) SAVED ISLAM
